dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: Visible as multiple thin, low-contrast horizontal tiers of pale fringes across the median and greater coverts.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Sharp, high-contrast pale edges along the outer webs of the folded primary and secondary feathers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Low distinctness with a seamless color gradient and no linear boundary separating the crown from the mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly repetitive scalloped pattern across the mantle and scapulars resulting from dark-centered feathers with broad, pale buff margins.
